## Objective

Establish an auditable pre-change boundary and exact requirement-to-artifact decisions before any reusable source edit.

## Scope

- Required and conditional reusable source targets
- Protected active and unrelated paths
- Pre-change hashes, inventories, Git state, and impact matrix

## Entry conditions

- Q-001 has been answered in the canonical plan, the exact plan revision is approved, and source implementation is separately authorized.
- The source TRD remains readable at the recorded digest or a new inspected source record and reviewed plan revision account for any change.

## Exit criteria

- The protected baseline is current and reviewable.
- Every requirement has an exact changed-or-unchanged artifact disposition.
- No reusable or active target was modified during analysis.

## Risks

- The dirty worktree makes attribution and preservation checks essential.
- Conditional package participation could be mistaken for automatic edit authority.

### Risks

- The dirty worktree could cause pre-existing changes or deletions to be misattributed to this implementation.
- A directory-level comparison could silently omit existing generated residue.

### Acceptance criteria

- The baseline names every required source target and protected active path with a current existence state and reviewable hash or scoped status.
- The existing deletion of ROLES-depo/sys4ai-depot-ROLE.md, four unmanaged plan files, and pre-existing __pycache__ entries are identified as baseline state rather than implementation output.
- No target or protected file is changed while the baseline is captured.

### Planned verification

- Run scoped git status for required and protected paths and retain a concise result.
- Compute SHA-256 hashes for regular files and deterministic inventories for directory targets.
- Compare reusable and installed skill packages while excluding only the explicitly recorded pre-existing __pycache__ files.

### Risks

- A broad package-level mapping could conceal speculative edits.
- The matrix could treat installed project copies as writable targets.

### Acceptance criteria

- The matrix contains exactly one reviewed row for each of the 23 requirements and identifies every affected file or an explicit unchanged disposition.
- SKILLS-depo/task/SKILL.md and ROLES-depo/project-director-ROLE.md are confirmed as required change targets.
- Every candidate file under SKILLS-depo/agent-task/ and SKILLS-depo/manage-subagent-roles/ receives a requirement-linked changed or unchanged disposition before editing.
- Active .agents/skills copies, root guidance, the template project, and unrelated reusable assets are excluded from the write set.

### Planned verification

- Check the matrix has unique contiguous REQ-001 through REQ-023 rows.
- Compare each proposed file impact with the live source contract, helper, schema, metadata, templates, and tests.
- Run a reverse review from every proposed target artifact back to one or more requirements.
